eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lane, OR; at 10:40 PM on AUG 13, 2023 Effective until 6:40 AM AUG 14, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an emergency notice from the LANE COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE. The following areas are being issued a Level 3 (GO NOW) evacuation notice due to wildfire: TAYLOR RD, NORTH  BANK RD, ALL AREAS OF HWY 126 BETWEEN BLUE RIVER RESERVOIR RD AND DRURY LN, MONA CAMPGOUND, LOOKOUT CAMPGROUND, H.J. ANDREWS HEADQUATERS. Level 3 means leave immediately! Do NOT take time to gather things. GO NOW! More information at www.LaneCounty.org/LookoutFire
